all_recorded_nonrow_fields_and_conclusio.scope:
Evaluate R71's nonprojected ruled continuation on an actual finite entry.

Input is a saved successful outward-coast finite Fourier IVP with a''=0 at
its endpoint. Use actual projected left velocity and the original material
angle, so the finite map matches its incoming first jet exactly. Its small
entry metric/frame defects are NOT discarded. The actual two-dimensional
metric and curvature are computed from derivatives of the resulting map;
the boundary second-jet defect is reported rather than silently removed.
All bounds here are samples, and this is still only a surface with boundary.

The finite Fourier Frenet initial-value system is not a validated existence
method in its elliptic regime. Failed refinement or domain exit is retained
as a failed probe, not interpreted as nonexistence. All extrema are samples.

Exact one-piece background budget for a new positive initial speed pulse.

This creates no prefix/tail BVP or surface.  It preserves the initial radius,
zero initial radial speed, initial acceleration k0, total radius increase
delta, and final radial speed V with zero final acceleration.  A pulse of
height b shortens the meridian segment.  Exact rational interval Bernstein
bounds certify only this surface-of-revolution background piece, not the
deformed actual field, its global diameter, reach, or a continuation branch.
